description: Test suite for OAuth DCR (Dynamic Client Registration) URL pattern matching and validation functions in the Mattermost project.

methods.name: TestClientRegistrationRequestIsValid
methods.description: Tests validation logic for ClientRegistrationRequest, including client type, redirect URI, and auth method validation.

methods.name: TestNewOAuthAppFromClientRegistration
methods.description: Tests creation of OAuth app from client registration request, verifying properties and dynamic registration flag.

methods.name: TestRedirectURIMatchesGlob
methods.description: Tests URL matching logic with glob patterns, including wildcards, host, port, and multiple pattern allowlist.

methods.name: TestIsValidDCRRedirectURIPattern
methods.description: Validates the correctness of DCR redirect URI patterns, including allowed schemes and wildcard usage.
